summary: Validated new auth flow (Emergent Google Auth) and grouped global search in Home. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed for /api/auth/me, /api/auth/username (2-24 length + uniqueness 409), /api/auth/logout (session invalidation) and root. Frontend: Login page with google-signin-button, Onboarding shown when custom_username is null and persists to sidebar-username, grouped search in Home works with 4 group testids and filter/clear-filters, Profile edit-username updates sidebar via /api/auth/username, new question flow, task creation, and logout redirecting to Login all work. Existing flows smoke-tested OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth_me route defines unused `current` parameter (None) — cosmetic; not a functional bug.
App.tsx is a 339-line single file mixing many components; consider splitting for maintainability (>300 lines threshold approaching).
Uniqueness check for custom_username is a simple find_one — under concurrency two users could set same name; consider a unique index on users.custom_username for stronger guarantees.
logout returns 200 even when no token is supplied; harmless but could return 401 for clarity.
test_credentials: Seeded MongoDB users/user_sessions in test_database with TEST_ prefix; tokens are ephemeral per test run.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/cleanup TEST_ users+sessions per module. Frontend test seeded two throwaway users (onboarding + ready) directly in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses cookie session_token (sameSite=None/secure) AND Authorization: Bearer <token>; both paths tested and working. To bypass Google OAuth for UI testing, seed users+user_sessions in Mongo and set the session_token cookie for the preview domain via playwright add_cookies. Beware that calling /api/auth/logout deletes the session row, so if you re-use the same token afterwards you must re-seed it. Grouped search testids: search-group-{dudas|personas|recursos|grupos|asignaturas}; filters: search-filter-{subject|type|status}; clear-filters-button.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Only test-scaffolding issue: after step 8 (logout) the seeded READY session was deleted server-side, causing the subsequent responsive re-login step to see the Login page. Non-blocking.
